message: The other day, I was sorting through our go-bags when my phone buzzed—a message from our family group chat. It was my daughter, asking if we had enough water stored for everyone. In between giggles about my ‘survivalist’ tendencies, we all started sharing our ideas on what should be in our kits. 🏕️ It reminded me that preparedness isn’t just about supplies, but also about keeping the lines of communication open. How do you stay connected with your loved ones during planning?
